Only caller-owned actions can be dismissed. A false updated result means no transition occurred, not that the current status is necessarily dismissed.

functions.name: update-conversation

tags.instructions: Get conversationId and existing labels with `get-conversation` first when preserving labels. Omitted fields stay unchanged; labels replaces the whole map, and {} clears it. A title-and-label update may partially complete. Use `update-conversation-privacy` for visibility instead.

functions.name: update-conversation-crm-intelligence

functions.name: update-conversation-linked-crm-records
functions.description: Replace the complete set of external CRM records linked to a conversation.

functions.name: update-conversation-opportunity

functions.name: update-conversation-privacy
